d.ko: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.
d.en: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.
d.zh: 从自家车库起步，打造赛车工厂的模拟经营游戏。淘旧件、买新件，或自主设计零件，维修赛车，一步步攀登各级赛事。资金紧张，零件不断磨损，艰难的抉择接踵而至：维修、升级，还是偿还债务，让车队继续生存？
